analysis.purpose: The test suite for embeddings — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: CharNgramEmbedder — determinism; CharNgramEmbedder — generalization (the whole point); CharNgramEmbedder — normalization; vector codec — float32 BLOB round-trip.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of embeddings
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
